runner_control.changes: CPU identity display supports Linux; round-trip/context checks are unchanged.

hypothesis: Measure actual quantized MLP activation frequencies and first/second moments as preparation for a future activation-aware model experiment. This telemetry must preserve the baseline archive.
rule: Instrument only the result of qgemv_relu2q in model_opt.cpp. Count executed calls per layer, and per-neuron nonzero occurrences, sum(q), sum(q*q), using integers. Keep weights, depth, retrieval, priors, context, order and compiler flags unchanged.
acceptance: Exact prepared and original XML restoration
Archive bytes and SHA-256 identical to the saved uninstrumented baseline
Context counts unchanged; activation reports exactly equal for encoder and decoder
All 16 layers present, vector widths and integer moments consistent, source rewrite verified
Record failures; reject telemetry if it perturbs the archive
limitations: Counts include every executed MLP call across ordinary text and inserted prompts; they do not separate token roles.
Adaptive-depth skips mean different layers can have different call totals.
Observed inactivity is not universal deadness, and activation magnitude is not causal importance.
Both fixtures are reused research data, not unseen validation. No pruning candidate or size improvement is claimed.
followup: Summarize coverage and the activity of the already rejected weight-norm removals. Any new selection formula, budget and container hashes need a separate frozen experiment before reading its coder results.
scope: Read-only native fixture diagnostics; no trained-model change, performance claim or prize score.
